findings.suggested_fix: Use standard contemporary Afrikaans for the title. Replace the archaic pronoun “Gij” with modern “Jy”. Suggested title: "Jy moet weer gebore word" (preserve capitalization style used on site).

findings.source_quote: Dear ones, God wants a people to call His own today just as much as He did in the beginning. He wants us!
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the apparent typo/nonstandard address “Bestees,” to a standard contemporary Afrikaans form. Suggested fixes: “Bestees,” -> “Liewe lesers,” or “Bestees” -> “Liewe geliefdes,” depending on the intended tone. A simple, neutral suggestion: replace with “Liewe lesers,” so the sentence begins: “Liewe lesers, God wil vandag ’n volk hê …”.
findings.translation_quote: Bestees, God wil vandag ’n volk hê om Sy eie te noem net soos Hy dit aan die begin wou hê.
